Priya: Quick call—ping-pong tourney Friday? 12:30pm in the kitchenette. Winner gets a trophy (aka jar of quarters) + bragging rights :table_tennis:
Alex: I'm in. Can we do 1pm instead? lunchtime meetings usually at 12:30 :grimacing:
Jamal: 1pm works for me. Sign me up for singles and doubles.
Rachel: I'll bring paddles and a spare net. Also willing to be scorekeeper :raised_hands:
Emily: I'll sponsor a $25 coffee card for the winner. Also donut side-bet? Loser brings donuts Monday :doughnut:
Priya: Love it. Loser = the player who gets first 5 points? Or full match loser? thoughts?
Alex: First to 11, win by 2. Loser donut rule sounds good.
Jamal: Can we have a quick sign-up sheet? @ops-bot can you drop a 1-click poll here?
ops-bot: Poll created: "Ping-pong Friday 1pm?" Options: Yes / No / Prefer 12:30 — Vote with reactions. Link: https://polls.redwood/pingpong-friday
Rachel: Voted. Also small MVP side-bet: best trick shot wins a free lunch from me :sunglasses:
Emily: Acknowledged — I'll buy donuts if I lose :laughing:
Priya: Cool. Current signups: Priya, Alex, Jamal, Rachel, Emily. Anyone else? cc: @everyone :table_tennis:
Ben: I'm tempted. If someone throws in an extra coffee I'll enter :stuck_out_tongue:
Alex: Ben you're on. See you Friday 1pm. Bracket to be posted after signups close at 11am Friday.
Priya: Bracket will be in #random by 11:05. Reminder: wear non-marking shoes please. :memo:
